headlines.text: Flash back to 2024, when the AEW TBS Title was up for grabs as Mercedes Mone vs. Kris Statlander went to war, appearing on Full Gear, rated 8.57 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. Mon? survived a leg-targeting attack from Statlander, capping a 20-minute classic with a rollup to retain the TBS Championship.

On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Chris Jericho vs. Tomohiro Ishii fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.34 ? a fantastic contest. For Tomohiro Ishii, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Ishii's chops left Jericho's chest a bloody mess in their first-ever meeting, but Jericho escaped with the ROH World Title intact via the Liontamer.

On a Saturday in 2024, back when gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Daniel Garcia vs. Jack Perry battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 6.32 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Garcia locked in the Sharpshooter to defeat Perry and become the new TNT Champion after a match that saw Perry throw him through a table.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2024, it was Bobby Lashley's first night in AEW against Swerve Strickland, appearing on Full Gear, rated 7.34 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Bobby Lashley made his AEW in-ring debut alongside the Hurt Syndicate, defeating Swerve Strickland in a hard-hitting brawl that included a table spot through the Spanish announce desk.

It was 2024 when Jay White chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a solid half-century of matches, facing Jay White vs. Adam Page on Full Gear, rated 7.83 ? a strong outing in a hard-fought men's division clash, part of the special Full Gear '24 card.

Rewind to 2022, when PAC reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Death Triangle vs. The Elite on Dynamite, rated 8.20 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle in an action-packed trios battle, on an outstanding Thanksgiving Eve '22 show that earned an overall rating of 8.17.
